channel.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
channel.desc: James Dainard has seen it all, but nothing quite like this. Longtime real estate deal-finders Buck and Will want to partner with James and step into the flipping world, but they're total rookies. Clueless about renovation but full of big ideas, they pitch James on a disaster of a house: a damaged roof, a choppy main floor, and a yard and deck that are more jungle than backyard.
